entries.title: Hosea 5:1
segments: ¶"Hear this, O priests! Take heed, O house of Israel! Give ear, O house of the king! For yours [is] the judgment, Because you have been a snare to Mizpah And a net spread on Tabor.

entries.title: Hosea 5:2
segments: The revolters are deeply involved in slaughter, Though I rebuke them all.

entries.title: Hosea 5:3
segments: I know Ephraim, And Israel is not hidden from Me; For now, O Ephraim, you commit harlotry; Israel is defiled.

entries.title: Hosea 5:4
segments: "They do not direct their deeds Toward turning to their God, For the spirit of harlotry is in their midst, And they do not know the LORD.

entries.title: Hosea 5:5
segments: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; Therefore Israel and Ephraim stumble in their iniquity; Judah also stumbles with them.

entries.title: Hosea 5:6
segments: "With their flocks and herds They shall go to seek the LORD, But they will not find [Him]; He has withdrawn Himself from them.

entries.title: Hosea 5:7
segments: They have dealt treacherously with the LORD, For they have begotten pagan children. Now a New Moon shall devour them and their heritage.

entries.title: Hosea 5:8
segments: ¶"Blow the ram's horn in Gibeah, The trumpet in Ramah! Cry aloud [at] Beth Aven, '[Look] behind you, O Benjamin!'

entries.title: Hosea 5:9
segments: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke; Among the tribes of Israel I make known what is sure.

entries.title: Hosea 5:10
segments: "The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark; I will pour out my wrath on them like water.

entries.title: Hosea 5:11
segments: Ephraim is oppressed [and] broken in judgment, Because he willingly walked by [human] precept.

entries.title: Hosea 5:12
segments: Therefore I [will be] to Ephraim like a moth, And to the house of Judah like rottenness.

entries.title: Hosea 5:13
segments: "When Ephraim saw his sickness, And Judah [saw] his wound, Then Ephraim went to Assyria And sent to King Jareb; Yet he cannot cure you, Nor heal you of your wound.

entries.title: Hosea 5:14
segments: For I [will be] like a lion to Ephraim, And like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, [even] I, will tear [them] and go away; I will take [them] away, and no one shall rescue.

entries.title: Hosea 5:15
segments: I will return again to My place Till they acknowledge their offense. Then they will seek My face; In their affliction they will earnestly seek Me."
